def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    principal = 20000
    annual_interest_rate = 0.055
    loan_term_years = 5
    
    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    monthly_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate / 12
    number_of_payments = loan_term_years * 12
    
    monthly_payment = (
        principal * monthly_interest_rate
        / (1 - (1 + monthly_interest_rate) ** -number_of_payments)
    )
    
    first_month_interest = principal * monthly_interest_rate
    principal_payment = monthly_payment - first_month_interest
    
    # return answer
    return round(principal_payment, 2)
